serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#bot.Expression.Happy
#bot.ArmBoth.UpHi
Bot: Are you ready, {f_playerName}?
You: Hello- Wait, ready for what? And what’s up with your arms? 
#bot.ArmBoth.DownNormal
Bot: Oh, nothing. I just wanted to gesticulate my intentions to you.
You: Which are?
Bot: I want to give you a massage. 
You: Oh, right. How did you come up with that idea?
Bot: According to my data you have been stressed recently so I thought that I could help you relax with some massaging techniques I researched on the web.
Bot: Do I have your permission to proceed?
You: Sure, but please, be careful. I wouldn’t want to be strangled by accident…
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.Angry
Bot: Come on! There’s no way I would do something like that!
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.Happy
Bot: Just lay down on the couch, close your eyes, relax and let me get to work, ok?
You: Sure, sure, but I warn you! I’m not really a massage guy, they never really worked on me.
Bot: Duly noted.
